rationale: The committee decides on 2 December 2026 and the team has six weeks and ten librarian hours. A rapid review updating the 2021 search can combine the safety estimate (claim c1) with the evidence on rule-out yield in older and kidney patients (claim c4) and on sampling failures (claim c3), which are what determine whether the change helps this unit. A local before-after evaluation would come after approval, not instead of the review.
alternatives: Full systematic review (refused: cannot finish before the committee meets)
Approve the change on the 2022 meta-analysis alone (refused: it does not answer the yield question for older patients)
Local before-after evaluation after a trial period (deferred: follows approval and needs the review's planning values)
guidelines: PRISMA 2020, with rapid review shortcuts stated
whyNotMoreComplex: Duplicate screening and author contact would not fit six weeks and are unlikely to change the direction of the safety estimate; the open questions are yield and implementation, which a focused rapid review can answer.

decision.statement: Narrow the rapid review to three questions the committee needs (30-day safety after one-hour rule-out, rule-out yield in older and kidney patients, and second-sample timing failures), leaving cost and staffing to the implementation plan, and report on 2 December 2026.
decision.question: What should the rapid review for the one-hour pathway decision cover?

criteria.text: Safety is well estimated where studied, but yield and sampling failures decide the local benefit.
A current review already reports yield by age and kidney function for district hospitals.

gates.requirement: Clinical librarian time for the update search
gates.evidence: Request CL-26-087 confirming ten hours between 20 October and 13 November 2026, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: A decision forum and date for the report
gates.evidence: Quality committee item QC-2026-51 for 2 December 2026, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Full systematic review after the decision
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1, c3 and c4 from retrieved records; the ungraded conference abstract carries no claim.

summary: Rapid review recommended and narrowed to safety, yield and sampling failures; both gates met.
